Picky eater refusing protein every night? Stop fighting at the dinner table and check their Zinc & IGF-1 levels first 🥦🧬

Clinical nutrition studies (AJCN) show that mild Zinc deficiency reduces gustin (carbonic anhydrase VI)—the enzyme that regenerates taste buds—making meat and greens taste bitter to kids while stalling liver IGF-1 bone growth.
